Open Settings › Sensor connection to choose USB, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and view the connection instructions.
To use Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, physically connect the sensor by USB at least once. Uvir will securely acquire its unique identity and access credentials.
Connect to the sensor remotely through a secure MQTT broker. No router port needs to be opened.
Keeps the sensor reachable through the configured MQTT broker.
Uses the network already configured in the Wi-Fi section.
Enter the MQTT broker address, TLS port and credentials. Sensor and app connect outward, so this also works with mobile routers and CGNAT.
You can change this setting by USB or through the other active wireless connection. If both radios are disabled, USB is required to re-enable one.
Sensor not connected. Use USB, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and try again.
Default and priority connection when the cable is inserted. You can still choose Wi-Fi or Bluetooth manually from the source menu.
Mock data is active in Settings. The selected real source will remain stored and will be used when the Debug override is disabled.
A disabled source can be re-enabled through the other active wireless connection. If both are disabled, connect the sensor by USB.

The sensor will enter a low-power shutdown and cannot be restarted from the app. To turn it on again, press EN/RESET or disconnect and reconnect its power. To confirm, press and hold POWER OFF for 2 seconds.

Dissociating removes this sensor from the selectable list, without deleting its name or saved records. You can associate it again by USB at any time. The sensor will not be changed. To confirm, press and hold DISSOCIATE for 2 seconds.
Could not change sensor. Try again.
Connect the new sensor by USB. Previously associated sensors remain in the list.

All app and sensor settings will be restored to their default values. All saved acquisitions, recorded alerts and error logs will be permanently deleted. The sensor will then power off. To confirm, press and hold RESTORE ALL continuously for 10 seconds.
The complete restore could not be performed. Check the sensor connection and try again.

All Uvir app settings and locally stored data will be deleted, including acquisitions, recorded value alerts, error logs, counters, sensor profiles and saved connection credentials. The sensor itself will not be changed or powered off. To confirm, press and hold RESTORE for 5 seconds.
The app settings could not be restored.
Software estimate based on the active connection, sampling and indicators. Actual consumption requires an external power meter.

Phone and sensor must use the same Wi-Fi network. You can save or change the network over USB or through an already active and authenticated Wi-Fi or Bluetooth connection. If no wireless connection is available, use USB.

The first USB connection securely associates the sensor with this phone. Select Bluetooth as the source while the cable is connected, then pair the displayed Uvir device in Android Settings. The connection is direct and authenticated.
VIS/NIR values are estimates in µW/cm² derived from typical AS7343 datasheet responsivity. Absolute calibration of this physical module still requires a calibrated optical reference.
Connect this sensor once by USB to securely obtain its unique name and access credentials.
Android does not allow apps to read a saved Wi-Fi password. Enter it only the first time: it is stored privately and is never exposed by the sensor over wireless connections.
Wi-Fi network saved to the sensor
Sensor not connected. Use USB, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and try again
Tools intended for app testing and diagnostics.
Overrides every real source and supplies simulated data to the entire app. Use only for development and testing: the values are not real measurements.

Exports a technical file containing app, phone, last known sensor and recorded error information. It does not include saved acquisitions, passwords, PINs or authentication credentials. Above 256 KB, older error entries are removed automatically while the most recent ones are retained.
Plays a diagnostic theme stored in the sensor through its buzzer and LEDs. It uses the configured volume and brightness and is available only while the connected sensor is idle.
Update the sensor firmware to use this diagnostic test.
Playback stopped because the sensor is no longer available.
Unable to share the error log.
Sampling is performed directly inside the sensor: the app receives only the processed final result.
Extreme-value trimming removes the highest and lowest samples and requires at least 3 samples.
When the interval is below 500 ms, the Live screen refreshes values every 500 ms while still processing every received sample.
Use 1–21 samples and a spacing between 150 and 5000 ms.
Use the bell on each group on the main screen, then choose the value and its limit. Here you can set repetition and sound.
Triggers when the value is equal to or above the limit.
Triggers when the value is equal to or below the limit.
Tap an option to preview it. Silent produces no sound or vibration, but alerts are still recorded. Final loudness also depends on the phone’s alarm volume.
Use non-negative limits and set a repeat interval between 1 second and 24 hours.
The current value alert session will end. Configured and recorded alerts will be kept.
Monitoring will start using the configured value alerts. You can add or remove alerts later without starting a new session.

resources.string: All recorded value alerts will be permanently deleted. To confirm, press and hold DELETE ALL continuously for 2 seconds.
Choose how numbers are displayed in the app. Exported or shared content always uses the international numeric format.
Choose the app interface language. Exported or shared content always uses English.
Manage the reset of counters and their associated data.
Export or manage stored data and counters, or restore the app and sensor to their default state.
Export or manage saved data and counters, or completely restore the app without changing the sensor.
Deletes all app and sensor data, restores the default settings, then powers off the sensor.
Deletes every setting and all data stored in the app. The sensor and the data still stored on it remain unchanged.
Deletes unsynchronized data stored on the sensor, resets its configuration and connection credentials, then powers it off.

Only the sensor will be restored. Its settings and connection credentials will return to their defaults; unsynchronized acquisitions, value alerts and errors stored on it will be deleted, then the sensor will power off. App settings and records already saved in Uvir will not change. To confirm, press and hold RESTORE for 5 seconds.
The sensor could not be restored. Check the connection and try again.
Deletes all saved acquisitions and recorded alerts, then resets their IDs and session IDs.
All saved acquisitions and recorded alerts will be permanently deleted. Their IDs and session IDs will restart from the beginning. To confirm, press and hold RESET ALL continuously for 5 seconds.
Permanently deletes all saved acquisitions and resets acquisition and session IDs.

Permanently deletes all saved acquisitions and resets acquisition and session IDs. The alert log and alert settings will not be changed. To confirm, press and hold RESET ALL continuously for 2 seconds.
Permanently deletes all recorded alerts and resets alert IDs.
Permanently deletes all recorded alerts and resets alert IDs. Saved acquisitions and alert settings will not be changed. To confirm, press and hold RESET ALL continuously for 2 seconds.
Stop automatic acquisition before resetting the counters.
Exports a complete copy of the Uvir database, including saved acquisitions and the value alert log, through the Android sharing menu.
¹ Experimental broad-band estimates derived from the acquired channels. They are not medical, diagnostic, or safety assessments. The model will be refined after real-sensor calibration.
Exploratory relative index weighted toward shorter UV bands.
Exploratory relative index dominated by UVA exposure.
Exploratory relative index based on the derived 400–500 nm HEV band.

0–100 shows how strongly the acquired spectrum is concentrated in wavelengths weighted by this estimate. It describes spectral composition, not total intensity. It is not a percentage of damage and not a safety threshold.
All saved acquisitions will be permanently deleted. To confirm, press and hold DELETE ALL continuously for 2 seconds.
This acquisition will be permanently deleted.
¹ High Energy Visible (high-energy visible light): the sum of the violet and blue components.
¹ Bandwidth at half maximum: about 60 nm (Far-red) and 54 nm (NIR).

Spectral acquisition app for ultraviolet, visible and infrared radiation.
Spectral bands: Ultraviolet • Visible light • Infrared
Supported sensors: AS7331 UV • AS7343 multispectral
HEV, HEB and estimated biological effects are derived values calculated from the acquired spectral data.

When the phone is unreachable, the sensor stores completed acquisitions and alerts locally and synchronizes them after reconnection.
When no operation or synchronization is active and the app remains disconnected, the sensor enters low-power shutdown after the selected time. It must then be reactivated physically.

Checks every sample, including between acquisitions. Stops immediately when the condition is met.
Collects a measurement as soon as the condition is met. After saving, pauses condition checks for the full interval, then resumes.
